sources.name: NHS England Green plan guidance
facts: refreshed green plans were due 31 July 2025
ICBs and trusts report annual progress with quantitative progress data
there is no requirement for NHS organisations to calculate and report organisational carbon footprints
Scope 1, 2 and 3 disclosure is not required for NHS bodies because NHS England reports it

sources.name: Greener NHS organisations
facts: NHS has tracked and reported its carbon footprint since 2008
ICBs and trusts publish annual green-plan progress in annual reports
reporting requirements are linked to DHSC accounting manual, FT annual reporting manual and NHS Standard Contract

sources.name: Delivering a net zero NHS
facts: NHS Carbon Footprint net zero target is 2040
NHS Carbon Footprint Plus target is 2045
direct emissions reported down 68% since 1990 and 14% in the last five years

sources.name: NHS Net Zero Supplier Roadmap April 2027 milestone
facts: supports carbon-reduction-plan and emissions-reporting requirements for suppliers

global_operations: NHS organisational and national reporting boundaries are explicitly separated
No invented organisational footprint where guidance says none required
NHS national/organisation targets not promoted to parcel values
